profile.name: Jack Yang
biography: Jack Yang is a Shanghai-born media artist whose practice engages with Technoetic Aesthetics, cyberception, and bioart, with a particular focus on moistmedia.

His work explores research in biological sciences, chemistry and biochemistry, neuroscience, and their entanglements with Artificial Intelligence. Working across digital media and organic matter, his practice encompasses multiple media and forms.

works.title: Vibrational Shifts
works.alt: A perforated white panel beside a screen displaying fragmented city images.
works.status: Paper presented at ISEA 2025. Co-authored with Clarissa Ribeiro.
body: Vibrational Shifts explores urban soundscapes through Taoist ideas of resonance, cyclical movement, and wu wei. Noise data takes the form of irregular openings in a physical panel.
Ultrasonic sensors respond to the audience’s hand movements. Through Arduino and p5.js, proximity changes the speed of layered sounds and rearranges fragments of urban photographs.

works.title: Me_Eat Jack
works.alt: Me_Eat Jack: a cell culture packaged in a supermarket-style tray labelled Jack.
works.status: Paper presented at ISEA 2024. Co-authored with Clarissa Ribeiro.
body: Me_Eat Jack brings laboratory cell culture, a staged bone-marrow sampling performance, and supermarket packaging into the same encounter. A QR code leads to a digital record, borrowing the language of food traceability.

Developed with scientists at Shanghai Jiao Tong University’s College of Basic Medical Sciences, the work uses mouse-derived cells and a simulated sampling procedure. The apparent transformation of the artist into a meat product asks where we draw the line between human and animal, self and commodity.

works.title: Moltastasis
works.alt: Moltastasis prototype with a laptop, Arduino wiring, and a piezoelectric sensor in a laboratory.
works.status: Paper presented at Consciousness Reframed 2024. The proposed therapeutic and consciousness exchanges are speculative, not demonstrated outcomes.
body: Cocktail Therapy (Consciousness Integration): Moltastasis imagines an exchange between human participants and cellular systems through vibration. The prototype explores piezoelectric sensors, Arduino, and p5.js.

Its proposed use of AI-mediated vibration and tumour cell lines belongs to a speculative artistic inquiry into communication and consciousness. At the stage documented in the paper, the work did not cultivate cancerous tissue.

works.title: The Cosmist of Forking Paths
works.kind: Visual novel / 小径分岔的宇宙（主义者）
works.alt: A wall of CRT monitors showing static, from the project’s visual reference materials.
body: A person trapped inside a weapon supplies it with energy through pain. Across three interweaving narrative threads, the story moves between physical confinement, imagined freedom, and an inherited account of an ancestor who disappeared.
The character begins to act outside the choices offered to the player. In the script’s imagined cosmology, being remembered by an audience becomes another way of existing beyond the medium.
